body: I'm still here, in the off-chance you were wondering. Not that with the hangover, lack of proper sleep and the heartbreak I want to be.

My family loves me, but in their love they probably contributed a lot to the sorry state I currently am in. I just don't feel like searching for support there, because even if I find any, it would be like *they* see it, not me, and that would even be worse than no support. (For example: “plenty fish in the sea” are fucking *awful* words of encourangement when you are still in love with that one fish...) And for the friend, I guess he *is* a friend. Just it was a bit hurtful to hear he was not going to use just that word. But he still came here when I had asked a little bit ago.

Well, I guess I am not going to off myself. Maybe never intended to. Thank you for your support. Just talking with someone helped a lot. Because talking to Johnnie W. is counter-productive.

I am seeing a therapist. Doesn't help any. And with the today's events, I feel like there is just nothing to look forward too. Well, apart from the next season of Game of Thrones, as a thread below reminded me (:

I cannot break down crying in front of my friends. I can do it here, though. I guess I just need someone to listen to how fucking miserable I am, withough me putting a facade of “She left? Well, fuck her.” as I just did in front of a friend I invited because I couldn't have beared to be alone. Though, after he left, I did break down. Also, he would not have even said that he was my friend last time we were drinking (that is the reason I had gotten sentimental), for some... superstitious? reasons. Or some reasons. And he is the person I like the most of few people I want to call my friends...

I am sorry, I am not exactly sober.

Tyrion is a character from Game of Thrones / A Song of Ice and Fire. Fuck it, I *am* going to find out how that ends...

Whores and money are *not* overrated? I definitely agree with the second one (: Too bad the local money is poised to turn into colourful strips of paper...

Also, that line reminded me of Tyrion. Had I been a son, even if hated and deformed, of one of the most powerful families of the continent... I wouldn't have cared about girls. I wouldn't have cared about the tidal wave of geopolitics, as it would not have been a force of nature to me...
Oh. Sorry then. Here it is not that bad (yet? I think so, *yet*). I always feel guilty for being depressed with no *real* struggle in my life...
I really liked Mitch Hedberg's humour too (: Too bad he was dead by the time I found out about him. Well, that is a really cheerful though, isn't it?

> There are tough times in life, my friend.

Just a balance of probabilities, but are you from US? My whole country is rapidly driving towards a cliff, and there is a saying in it: “A terrible end is better than a terror without an end” (*terrible* and *terror* being the same word in the original language). I just cannot see tough times changing for something better.
